dialogue.content: こんにちはメンタルトレーナーです。本日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a mental trainer. It's nice to meet you today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます😊宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. 😊 I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: はじめに、年齢、性別をおしえていただけますか
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 65歳女シです♪
dialogue.English: I’m a 65-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 主人を怒らせることが多いのです
dialogue.English: I often end up making my husband angry.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それは困りますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: どんなことで怒らせてしまうのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What kinds of things tend to make him angry?

dialogue.content: 言わなくても解りそうなことまで　いちいち説明して欲しいらしいです
dialogue.English: He seems to want me to explain every little thing, even things that should be obvious without saying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、一つ一つ説明するのは面倒に感じてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand. It must feel tiresome to have to explain everything step by step.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 説明すると、お互いどんな感じになりますか？
dialogue.English: When you do explain, how does it feel for each of you?

dialogue.content: 私はえー、また一からですか？って思う　主人は説明が悪いしと怒る
dialogue.English: I think, 'Oh, do I have to start from square one again?' and my husband gets angry and says my explanation is poor.

dialogue.content: それはずれを感じてしまって、辛いですよね、、
dialogue.English: That must feel like you're not on the same page, which must be difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自身はこの相談でどんなことを一番扱いたいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: What would you most like to address in this session?

dialogue.content: 主人と仲良く暮らすことを目的として
dialogue.English: My goal is to live harmoniously with my husband.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: うんうん、夫さんと仲良く暮らしていきたい
dialogue.English: Mhm, you want to live harmoniously with your husband.

dialogue.content: 何かを説明するときに怒らせてしまうとのことですが、それ以外では夫さんと普段どんなふうにやりとりされておられますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned he gets angry when you’re explaining something; aside from that, how do your everyday interactions with him usually go?

dialogue.content: 普段は大丈夫ですが　プレッシャーがかかると怒る
dialogue.English: Usually, things are fine, but he gets angry when he's under pressure.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、イライラされるとこちらもどうしていいか分からなくなりますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. When he gets irritated, it can be hard to know how to react, can't it?

dialogue.content: そうです♪私はイライラしないので
dialogue.English: That's right.♪ Because I don't get irritated.

dialogue.content: うんうん、ご自身はそういう時でもいつも通りなのですね
dialogue.English: Mhm, so you stay calm as usual even at times like that.

dialogue.content: 夫さんがプレッシャーがかかる時はどんな時でしょうか？
dialogue.English: When does your husband feel under pressure?

dialogue.content: 解る筈だが
dialogue.English: He should be able to understand...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 上手くいっていない時かな
dialogue.English: I suppose it's when things aren't going well for him.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね「解る筈だが」はご自身がそう思っている感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you said, 'He should be able to understand,' is that how you feel about it?

dialogue.content: はい　キャパが小さいから、大変だなぁ、みたいに
dialogue.English: Yes. It's like I think, 'He has a low tolerance for this, it must be hard for him.'

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じておられるのですね
dialogue.English: That's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そういったことが起こるのはいつもでしょうか？それとも特定の何かの話題の時でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does this kind of thing happen all the time? Or only when you're discussing certain topics?

dialogue.content: 多たあります
dialogue.English: It happens quite often.

dialogue.content: 私がせっかち
dialogue.English: I'm impatient.

dialogue.content: いつもそうなると説明するのもしんどくなりますよね、、
dialogue.English: If it's always like that, explaining things must become very draining.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: せっかちかなと自分のこと感じておられるのですね
dialogue.English: So you feel that you might be a bit impatient yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私が先に行き過ぎと言われます
dialogue.English: He tells me that I get too far ahead.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに言われると、傷つきますよね、、
dialogue.English: It must be hurtful to be told something like that.

dialogue.content: 解っているはずのことをいちいち説明させられて嫌になるご自身は夫さんと仲良くくらしたいと思っておられます
dialogue.English: So, you dislike having to explain every little thing that you feel he should already understand, but at the same time, you want to live harmoniously with your husband.

dialogue.content: 傷だらけは大丈夫ですが1生は長くないと思うんです
dialogue.English: I can handle getting hurt, but I don’t think life is very long.

dialogue.content: 私にせめる気持ちが有るんですね♪
dialogue.English: I guess there's a part of me that blames him.♪

dialogue.content: うんうん、一生は長くないからこそ仲良く暮らしていきたいですよね、、
dialogue.English: Mhm, and it's precisely because life isn't long that you want to live harmoniously together.

dialogue.content: 自身でも、つい責めてしまう気持ちに気づいておられるのですね、、
dialogue.English: So you've become aware of this feeling within yourself, that you tend to blame him.

dialogue.content: いちいち説明させられたら、
dialogue.English: When you’re made to explain every little thing,

dialogue.content: ついがっと責めてしまいたくもなりますよね、、
dialogue.English: it's natural that you might impulsively want to blame him.

dialogue.content: 仲良く暮らしていくために、コミュニケーションを考えていきたいと思いますが
dialogue.English: To live harmoniously, I’d like us to think together about communication.

dialogue.content: 今自己分析が出来ました
dialogue.English: I've just had a moment of self-analysis.

dialogue.content: 時間となりましたので、終了とさせていただきます。どうも有難うございました。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up, so we will have to conclude for today. Thank you very much.
